purpose: Introduce the Prime Labyrinth at P7 as a readable traversal chamber with one true forward route to P11 (3,3,5), one clear return route, and an unobstructed first-person movement lane.
runtimeSurface: Blender 4.3 authored source with a later Three.js/WebGL runtime export at 1280x720.

hero.role: The only forward gameplay destination; a real Boolean opening with threshold, wall reveal, and at least 8 m of visible passage depth.

exceptions: The forward gate uses a seven-spoke crown whose odd radial motif is centered on, and does not displace, the bilateral room axis.

circulation.description: A straight 4.0 m-wide route runs north-south between the 4.0 m arrival aperture and the 4.8 m forward gate. The paired pylons sit outside this lane, leaving side recovery zones and an unobstructed stopping envelope.
